reviews.title: No free version available anymore
reviews.text:
Sad to see this app go fully subscription based. I’m sure that just like me, many others used this app quite rarely, so I cannot even imagine paying 9$ / WEEK!!! to make some collages. It’s of course a scam, surviving on the hope that people will forget to cancel the subscription.

Update:
To make things even better, the Grid team decided to ChatGPT a reply for this review with no effort to even try to make it sound less ChatGPT haha, straight copy paste. Tell ChatGPT that there is no use you can make of this app to make it worth 9$/ week. That’s literally what I pay for photoshop, if not less. Also, if there is a free version, you did a very good job hiding it on the paywall. I’ve had your app on my phone for years and used the free version 2-3 times/ year. But this time I couldn’t get past the paywall. Just fyi, I do appreciate that you need to be paid somehow and I would be totally fine to pay a one off fee for your app, but charging 9$/ week for an app to make collages is a scam in any reality you might be living in.
